annotation.bound_parties_text: The vehicle manufacturer (or its authorized representative) must apply for approval and meet the DCAS requirements, and the Type Approval Authority must assess documentation and verify conformity of production.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the DCAS shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by the manufacturer’s authorized representative to the Type Approval Authority
annotation.dates_quote: Date of entry into force: 22 September 2024
annotation.robot_provision_quote: UN Regulation No 171 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to Driver Control Assistance Systems (DCAS) [2024/2689]
